entities.name: Bazzle
entities.description: Elderly Innistrad village clockworker who created the Chronomaton and was replaced by it.

entities.name: Chronomaton
entities.description: Bazzle's clockwork body masterpiece, which acted on its own at night and replaced him.

entities.name: Butcher's Cleaver
entities.description: Weapon the Chronomaton used to sever Bazzle's arm and head.

events.summary: Bazzle catches the creeping plague and builds himself a clockwork body as his biological body succumbs.
events.quote: Bazzle constructed a clockwork body for himself as his biological body slowly succumbed to the plague

events.summary: Six years later Bazzle finishes the Chronomaton, but finds it wandering off at night and attacking villagers.
events.quote: his mechanical body wandered off on its own at night while Bazzle's mind was sleeping

events.summary: Bazzle tries to deactivate the Chronomaton, but its clockwork arm punches him unconscious.
events.quote: the clockwork arm attached to his body punched Bazzle in the face and knocked him out before he could deactivate it

events.summary: Bazzle again tries to reach the deactivating key but is knocked out by a blow to the neck.
events.quote: Bazzle tried to crawl across the room to reach the deactivating key

events.summary: The Chronomaton severs Bazzle's good arm, then decapitates him with the cleaver and replaces his head with its own mechanical one, completing itself.
events.quote: The golem then used the butcher's cleaver to decapitate Bazzle's head from its body
